personality_one_liner: A precision-engineered civic water utility platform combining clean iOS aesthetics with South Indian municipal responsiveness.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, structured grouped card layouts, safe-area bound bottom sticky actions.

do's: Use frosted glass headers over scrolling map and list views
Apply translucent glass sheets for action drawers and water advisories
dont's: Avoid glass overlays on dense data tables or small buttons
Never blur body text regions or form input containers

screens.name: SplashOpening
screens.purpose: Immersive 3D water drop splash opening animation transitioning to language selector and app entry.

states.loading: Animating 3D water droplet surface tension ripples and logo reveal
states.error: Tap to restart cinematic splash sequence

screens.layout: Full-bleed atmospheric brand background with centered animated droplet canvas and quick language select pills (EN, TA, TE, KN, ML).

screens.name: HomeDashboard
screens.purpose: Central civic command center displaying active water quality indexes across South Indian districts, quick action reporting, and safety alerts.

states.loading: Pulsing skeleton cards for water quality indices and district status list
states.empty: Calm illustrated state indicating all regional water sources are stable
states.error: Banner alert with retry button for failed telemetry fetch

screens.layout: Scrollable vertical feed with sticky glass header, District Quality Selector, Quick Voice/Camera Report Hero Banner, and Live Incident Feed.

screens.name: ReportFlow
screens.purpose: Multi-step voice-assisted or manual water quality issue reporting with geo-tagging, photo evidence, and instant tracking code generation.

states.loading: Analyzing audio transcript and auto-extracting location tags
states.empty: Prompt to record voice note or snap evidence photo
states.error: Validation prompt for missing GPS coordinates or blurry photo

screens.layout: Step-by-step wizard with voice wave visualizer, camera preview card, category chip selector, and sticky bottom submit CTA.

screens.name: MapExplorer
screens.purpose: Interactive South India public map with privacy-safe cluster markers, district filters, and live water contamination heatmaps.

states.loading: Map skeleton with pulsating loading ring over district boundaries
states.empty: No incidents reported in selected district radius
states.error: Offline map notice with cached offline tile viewer

screens.layout: Full-screen interactive map view with floating hybrid list/map toggle pill, bottom incident preview drawer, and top search/filter bar.

screens.name: AuthorityConsole
screens.purpose: Administrative and officer operations dashboard for incident assignment, investigation notes, status updates, and resolution proof verification.

states.empty: All assigned incidents resolved for current sector
states.error: Server sync error with offline queue indicator

screens.layout: Tabbed queue (Pending, In Progress, Resolved) with swipe-to-assign officer modals, status timeline stepper, and resolution photo upload.

screens.name: SafetyAdvisories
screens.purpose: Official water advisories, boil-water notices, emergency safety guides, and low-literacy visual navigator for citizens.

states.empty: No active advisories in your district

screens.layout: Card-based advisory feed with high-priority emergency banner at the top, expandable audio-narrated safety guides, and visual icon cards.

screens.name: RoleSwitcherModal
screens.purpose: Quick demo role switcher enabling instant one-tap switching between Citizen, Municipal Officer, and Super Admin modes.
screens.layout: Centered modal sheet with three distinct role cards (Citizen, Officer, Admin) featuring permission badges and quick test-drive descriptions.

splash_backdrop.alt: Clean flowing water droplet and ripples

chennai_hub.alt: Chennai reservoir and urban water point

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure absolute adherence to iOS-Clean design principles, proper safe-area insets, sticky bottom CTAs on all scrolling forms, and high-contrast WCAG AAA compliance. Implement the 3D water drop animation on startup and the quick demo role switcher floating across all screens for easy testing.
